items.raw_excerpt: Tres tardes, varias historias que escuchar y una realidad que muchas familias conocen demasiado bien.
items.summary_en: A small village in Leon, Spain set aside one week to care for neighbors who are losing their memory. Families and volunteers visited them to keep them company and offer support. The effort aims to raise awareness about dementia in the area.
